primitive: REG_OLS / REG_GLM jackknife: delete-a-group (jackknife_by / jackknife_groups), weighted (JK1) and leave-one-out
r_function: manual deletions: lm / glm(control = glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14)) / glmnet(alpha = 0, standardize = FALSE) on the rows outside each delete group
note: rows are [x1, x2, y, w, c]; c is the delete-group id, w a frequency weight. SE = sqrt((g - 1)/g * sum_k (b_(k) - bbar)^2); vcov the same scaled cross-product. Unweighted unpenalised cluster cases are cross-checked against survey JK1 (mse = FALSE) at relative 1e-8. leave_one_out cases make every row its own group.
